text:
sophia_support: FYI customer ACME-42 says their invoice shows ~25% more embed units than what the dashboard reports. They sent invoice #INV-2027-1121 and a sample of the API payloads. Asking for triage and whether this is a metering bug or UX mismatch.

mike_billing: Can you paste the invoice line item and a couple of request examples? I’ll pull billing logs once I have those. :eyes:

sophia_support: Invoice line: "embeddings: 1,240,512 units" but dashboard shows 992,000 for same period. Attached CSV: s3://acme-42/support/usage-sample-2027-03-09.csv

ashley_eng_ml: Quick hypothesis: did they use rerank /pairwise mode? Pairwise rerank charges queries*candidates. If their client sent 5 queries against 20 candidates that explodes counts vs naive per-input expectation.

jordan_research: Also need to check batching + retries. If the client retried without idempotency keys we could have duplicate accounting. Any sign of 409s/retries in logs?

sophia_support: They claim they used the SDK and didn't set idempotency keys manually. Sample request from their support file:

```json
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "embed-large-1536",
  "input": ["docA","docB","docC"],
  "batch": true
}
```

and the rerank call:

```json
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "model": "rerank-pairwise",
  "queries": ["q1","q2"],
  "candidates": ["docA","docB","docC","docD"]
}
```

sophia_support: They also attached an SDK trace with 2 automatic retries for a burst of 120 requests around 2027-03-09T14:12Z.

ingest-bot: logs: request_id=ri_0a1b2c retries=2 idempotency_key=null status=200 timestamp=2027-03-09T14:12:06Z

mike_billing: Ok, so three plausible contributors: pairwise rerank math, client-side retries without idempotency, and possible batching/padding differences (we charge per-record after internal padding to alignment). Can you confirm whether the dashboard applies any aggregation rules that hide pairwise counting? Dashboard might show "embedding operations" not pairwise rerank units.

ashley_eng_ml: Confirming: dashboard shows "embedding calls" and lists input count. Rerank pairwise billing is surfaced separately in invoices as "rerank pairwise units". But we've had a bug where the dashboard UI omitted pairwise units when a rerank call came in the same minute as embedding calls — UI dedup logic on the dashboard was too aggressive.

jordan_research: That would explain a delta. But need to verify invoice raw ledger. mike, can you pull raw ledger rows for INV-2027-1121 and grep for account ACME-42 between 2027-03-09T00:00 and 2027-03-10T00:00?

mike_billing: On it. Will also check for duplicate request_ids and repeated compute tokens. ETA ~30m.

sophia_support: Customer also reported some vectors were 1536 dims in response even though they expected 1024. Could that cause per-item rounding to a higher billing bucket?

ashley_eng_ml: Dimension mismatch alone doesn't change unit accounting, but it affects storage and some back-end padding behavior. If their client alternated models (1024 vs 1536) we might have charged both model types in invoice while dashboard rolled up by model family and collapsed them incorrectly.

ingest-bot: trace: replayable_events=3 duplicated_payload_hash=sha1:fd3c... note=retry_fired_no_idemp_key

mike_billing: Ledger shows invoice lines: embeddings 992,000 units, rerank_pairwise 248,512 units, total 1,240,512 units. Dashboard only rendered embeddings=992,000 and hid rerank_pairwise due to the UI dedupe bug Ashley mentioned.

sophia_support: So the invoice is correct and dashboard under-reported. Customer confused because UI didn't show the rerank line. They were running rerank pairwise on same day. Customer is asking for credit because they didn't realize pairwise charges.

jordan_research: We should reproduce quietly in staging: 1) send embedding batch + rerank pairwise 2) retry without idempotency keys 3) confirm ledger rows created once per processed request. I'll run a small replay script.

ashley_eng_ml: Also filing a UI bug to show rerank_pairwise lines and add a tooltip explaining pairwise math. Will post PR link.

mike_billing: For the customer: recommend refunding the unexplained portion if they can show they didn't intend pairwise mode. But since SDK defaulted to pairwise? Do we have product docs clarity? If SDK made it too easy to trigger pairwise, escalate to PM.

sophia_support: ACME-42 says they were using an internal wrapper that toggles pairwise=true for rerank. They didn't realize cost implication. They're asking for a one-time credit to cover the rerank units. I proposed a pro-rated credit and clearer dashboard messaging. Waiting on billing decision.

mike_billing: I'll provisionally issue a credit for the rerank_pairwise line (248,512 units) pending PM sign-off and docs update. I'll follow up with a credit note and updated invoice. :+1:

ashley_eng_ml: Filed UI ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGSUP-8743 (adds explicit rerank line to usage dashboard, tooltip + examples). PR incoming.

jordan_research: Repro steps for ENG:
1) In staging, send 3 embedding batches (varying model dims)
2) Send a rerank/pairwise request with 4 candidates x 2 queries
3) Replay with SDK retries without idemp key
4) Verify ledger rows: should see separate lines for embeddings and rerank_pairwise, and idempotent behavior should be absent for retry case

ingest-bot: action: scheduled replay job job_id=jr_2027_03_09_01 assigned=ashley_eng_ml

sophia_support: I'll send customer a note explaining root cause (pairwise rerank + dashboard UI dedupe) and that we're issuing a credit for the rerank units. Thanks everyone.

mike_billing: Closing loop: I'll update the invoice and post a comment here when complete.

sophia_support: thx :heart:
